title: Boolean Gate Lookup Table
statement: Define a table on pairs of Boolean inputs whose output consists of a conjunction or disjunction and two references to the sole position $0$, each tagged by a Boolean. On inputs $(	ext{false},	ext{false})$ it returns conjunction with tags $(	ext{true},	ext{false})$; on $(	ext{false},	ext{true})$ it returns conjunction with tags $(	ext{true},	ext{true})$; on $(	ext{true},	ext{false})$ it returns conjunction with tags $(	ext{false},	ext{false})$; and on $(	ext{true},	ext{true})$ it returns disjunction with tags $(	ext{true},	ext{false})$.
